method.per_observation: serial arithmetic mean milliseconds per transform; raw blocks retained
method.cold_import: fresh Deno eval processes; one untimed import per variant; cached-only and frozen lockfiles; filesystem/package/module caches warm; dynamic-import timing and process wall time separate
method.execution_control: same candidate runtime and Oxc TypeScript erasure for original/baseline-generated/candidate-generated numeric defaults; counted loop bound 1000

limitations: One host, serial in-process warmed transforms: shared JIT, GC, thermal state and system noise remain. Whole-block bootstrap describes these observations; it does not remove systematic bias. Fresh import is process-cold with warm filesystem caches. Workloads cover specific source shapes, not a universal speedup. TypeScript erasure executes fixtures without type checking.
